comments.value: We are interested in making avatar specific components like physbones, contacts and the new constraints usable in worlds in the future, but it won't be a focus during the constraints beta.
It is lamentable that DynamicBone is still being used at commercial events such as SanrioVirtualFestival.

@{5fc07f1638dc63605fb9833c|full_name} While the component is exposed, sure, you need to try uploading it first.

If you upload the World and it doesn’t work in the client, high chances you’ll get a Null Reference Exception Error in the Logs related to that.

That’s currently the case with PhysBones.
@{60283c7c4c9a9639a694c668|full_name} oh... you are right! I should have tested in VRC. Sad that we get to see it it action and works but doesn't upload...
@{65f4b1a3d0a7a0c657a7d3a8|full_name} Just saying, contacts in worlds would be INCREDIBLE! I really really want a way for worlds/udon to interact with avatars

@{5f3df2f75af9f322b0f66e1b|full_name} Hi, sorry for the delay in replying. We recommend checking our Creators Roadmaps for details about which features are currently being worked on: https://ask.vrchat.com/c/official/roadmaps/73

As mentioned earlier, we are interested in bringing avatar specific components to worlds in the future, but there are no plans for it at this time. Thanks for understanding.

@{65f4b1a3d0a7a0c657a7d3a8|full_name} Is this a technical limitation blocking this or a procedural issue with workload? I was intending to update my pool table prefab with the VRC constraints system as an optimization measure, but it seems like driving what should be done via constraints via Udon and eating the horrendous CPU cost ends up the least-bad option for long term maintenance if this is not going to be done.

We're working on adding dynamics to worlds!

Check out our latest roadmap update for more info: https://ask.vrchat.com/t/vrchat-creators-roadmap-july-2025/45859

Thank you for posting this request! Constraints are now available in the worlds SDK.

 Read the release notes below:

https://vrc-beta-docs.netlify.app/releases/release-3-9-1/

details: Please! It's uncool that we are still not getting PhysBones in the World SDK. So at least give us the VRC Constraints in the World SDK as well. We could all use it.
title: [VRC Constraints] Add VRC Constraints to the Worlds SDK.
